packageRules.description: Template content gets its own group so PRs clearly show whether an update is for the template package or the generated projects. Snapshots are included so they move in lockstep with the content they are generated from
Provided by the game and BepInEx at runtime; versions in generated projects must match what they ship
Don't pin action digests in generated projects; consumers can opt into pinning with their own Renovate config
Snapshot GameLibs versions come from test parameters (e.g. --game-version), not template content
